    (∑ j'', xC j'' j) + (n : 𝕜) * c j - (∑ j'', ∑ i, uC j'' i * A i j) :=
  by
  rw [show (∑ j'', (xC j'' j + (c j - ∑ i, uC j'' i * A i j))) = (∑ j'', (xC j'' j + c j …

rw [show (∑ j'', (xC j'' j + (c j - ∑ i, uC j'' i * A i j))) = (∑ j'', (xC j'' j + c j - ∑ i, uC j'' i * A i j)) from
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j'' _ => by ring)]
rw [show (∑ j'', (xC j'' j + c j)) = (∑ j'', xC j'' j) + (∑ _j'' : Fin n, c j) from Finset.sum_add_distrib]

rw [show (∑ _j'' : Fin n, c j) = (n : 𝕜) * c j from by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]]
have hR_sum_nn : 0 ≤ (∑ i', (xR i' j + (c j - ∑ i, uR i' i * A i j))) := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i' _ => hR_term i')

have hC_sum_pos : 0 < (∑ j'', (xC j'' j + (c j - ∑ i, uC j'' i * A i j))) :=
  Finset.sum_pos' (fun j'' _ => hC_term j'') ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, hC_strict_j⟩
